[[File:Recharge Dragonstone icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Recharge Dragonstone''' is a utility spell on the [[Lunar spellbook]], requiring 89 [[Magic]] and completion of the hard [[Fremennik Diary]] to cast.

This spell recharges any [[amulet of glory]], [[combat bracelet]], and [[skills necklace]] with 4 charges, although the latter two can only be recharged after completion of the [[Legends' Quest]].

This spell '''cannot''' charge the [[ring of wealth]]; only the [[Fountain of Rune]] in the deep [[Wilderness]] can do so.
